title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

ava.csm: Quick QBR prep for MeridianPay — need token economics + 90-day spend forecast for cost-optimization slide. Who can pull last 3 months usage and current unit costs? Any budget alerts in past 30 days? @diego_revops @samir_eng

diego_revops: On it. I can run a forecast and unit economics. Need customer_id + model mapping. Is MeridianPay using embed-only for lookup or full chat+embeds? I think they went chat+embeds.

priya_success: They started with chat+embeds during onboarding. Onboarding notes: prefix caching turned on, sampling lowered to temp=0.6 for prod. Also flagged payroll-run bursts last month (~Mar 16).

samir_eng: Confirming prod uses "redwood/gpt-3.5-lite" (quantized 8-bit) for chat, and "redwood/embed-lite" for embeddings. They ran a 4-bit quant test 2024-04-10 for a small subset — latency down ~12%, quality OK on core prompts.

diego_revops: Got usage raw. Quick numbers: last 90 days tokens_in/out = [120M, 95M, 150M] => total ~365M tokens. Current blended cost = $0.0006 per token (generation+embedding weighted). Monthly spend ~ Mar: $72k, Apr: $57k, May: $90k. Baseline 90-day forecast (no changes) ~ $240k.

ava.csm: Oof. Need to show 3 levers in QBR: (1) quantization to 4-bit for chat where tested, (2) increase prefix/KV caching for payroll flows, (3) move low-risk reranks to cheaper reranker model. Can you estimate savings per lever?

samir_eng: Back-of-envelope: 4-bit quant -> ~25% compute cost reduction on chat => ~20% overall spend drop if applied to all chat traffic. KV/prefix caching -> reduces token usage ~15% during bursts. Reranker swap -> per-call cost down 60% for ~10% of calls => ~6% net. Combined potential ~40% if stacked (not perfectly additive).

diego_revops: I'll prepare slide with current run-rate, forecast, and 3-tier scenario (no change / partial optimize / full optimize). Adding budget-alert history too. Quick query I ran to pull raw: ```
SELECT date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model, cost
FROM usage
WHERE customer_id = 'meridianpay'
AND date >= '2024-02-01'
ORDER BY date;
```

billing-bot: Alert: Budget threshold breached on 2024-04-28 (4.1% over threshold). Billing email sent to finance@meridianpay.com.

priya_success: I can run customer enablement checklist before QBR: confirm experiment windows, share playbook for quant rollout, and schedule enablement call with MeridianPay engineers next Wed. Ping me for deck notes.

ava.csm: Perfect — Diego and Samir please drop the slide draft by EOD Tuesday. Priya will own enablement and runbook. I'll own QBR narrative and ask for the forecast numbers in table form + delta savings per lever. :thumbsup:
